title: La Llorona (traditional), arranged for Gameplay+
credit: Traditional Mexican song, public domain. Arrangement: Gameplay+.
instruments_source: Rendered with the GeneralUser GS SoundFont (S. Christian Collins); its licence allows free use of rendered audio and does not require a credit.
license: Public-domain melody; arrangement and recording are part of Gameplay+.
mixing: Start every stem on the same sample and sum at unity gain; the full mix peaks at about -1 dBFS. Each Mayhem toggle adds the next stem.

stems.instrument: Acoustic Bass as guitarron, doubled in octaves (bank 0 prog 32); Timpani heartbeat and roll (bank 0 prog 47); Standard kit low/high conga as cajon + maracas (ch 10); Orchestral kit concert bass drum (bank 120 prog 48)
Trumpet (bank 0 prog 56), pitch-bend vibrato and falls, CC11 phrasing, plus a filtered two-tap canyon echo
Slow Strings (bank 0 prog 49), Tremolo Strings (bank 0 prog 44), Voice Oohs (bank 0 prog 53)
